features.name: Simplest Adaptive Streaming
features.description: A MediaPlayerElement plus a Load button. Loading a manifest URI implicitly creates an AdaptiveMediaSource via MediaSource.CreateFromUri and begins playback.
expected_behaviour: A MediaPlayerElement (with transport controls) is shown
A 'Load' button is present and, when clicked, sets the player source
Description text describing implicit AdaptiveMediaSource creation is visible

features.name: Event Handlers
features.description: Explicit AdaptiveMediaSource creation with all adaptive-streaming and playback-pipeline events logged. Load Id/Load Uri inputs, Set Source, AutoPlay, and a logging list box.
expected_behaviour: MediaPlayerElement with transport controls is present
Load Id / Load Uri / Set Source controls and AutoPlay checkbox are present
A logging list box exists to receive pipeline events
Bitrate readout text elements (download/playback) are present

features.name: Network Request Modification
features.description: Radio buttons select how outbound adaptive requests are modified (None, Authorization Header, Url Query Parameter, Application Downloaded) and HDCP policy (Off, On, On With Type Enforcement).
expected_behaviour: Seven radio buttons are present (4 request-modification modes + 3 HDCP modes)
Selecting a radio button changes the active mode
MediaPlayerElement and Load/Set Source controls are present

features.name: Adaptive Streaming Tuning
features.description: Combo boxes for desired min/initial/max bitrate, plus text boxes with Set buttons for downgrade-trigger and headroom-trigger ratios.
expected_behaviour: Three bitrate ComboBoxes are present
Two ratio TextBoxes each with an adjacent 'Set' button are present and editable
Clicking a 'Set' button applies the typed ratio
MediaPlayerElement and Load/Set Source controls are present

features.name: Metadata
features.description: Demonstrates consuming/creating timed metadata (ID3, m3u8 comments, emsg). Load inputs, Set Source, AutoPlay, logging list box.
expected_behaviour: MediaPlayerElement with transport controls is present
Load Id / Load Uri / Set Source / AutoPlay controls are present
A logging list box exists to receive timed-metadata events

features.name: Ad Insertion
features.description: Pre/mid/post-roll ad insertion with playback-progress reporting via custom TimedMetadataTracks.
expected_behaviour: MediaPlayerElement with transport controls is present
Load Id / Load Uri / Set Source / AutoPlay controls are present
A logging list box exists to receive playback-progress events

features.name: Live Seekable Range
features.description: Live playback controls: desired seekable-window size and live offset (text + Set), a position slider, Log Times, GoToStart/GoToLive, Play/Pause, and eight relative-seek buttons (<<15m, <<5m, <<30s, <<2s, 2s>>, 30s>>, 5m>>, 15m>>).
expected_behaviour: MediaPlayerElement and Load/Set Source controls are present
DesiredSeekableWindowSize and DesiredLiveOffset text boxes each with a Set button are present
